title: Aries
interpretation: Aries is the mover — self-assertive, action-first. Values directness; learns through starting and leading. Lessons: channel impulse into sustained leadership.

title: Taurus
interpretation: Taurus aims for stability and quality; focuses on resources, the body and values; strength in persistence.

title: Gemini
interpretation: Gemini organizes and transmits information; adaptable and curious, thrives on exchange.

title: Cancer
interpretation: Cancer concerns security and emotional bonds; instinctive, relational, and protective.

title: Leo
life_phrase: I will be seen / I create.
interpretation: Leo is expressive and regal; seeks recognition and creative leadership.

title: Virgo
interpretation: Virgo discriminates and perfects; excels in systems and service; shadow in hyper-critique.

title: Libra
interpretation: Libra mediates and values harmony; oriented to relationships and balance.

title: Scorpio
interpretation: Scorpio probes transformation through crisis and intimacy; themes of control and rebirth.

title: Sagittarius
interpretation: Sagittarius quests for meaning through travel, belief and teaching; expansive and candid.

title: Capricorn
interpretation: Capricorn builds through time and structure; practical and reputation-focused.

title: Aquarius
interpretation: Aquarius reframes social forms; idealistic and inventive, values collective progress.

title: Pisces
interpretation: Pisces dissolves boundaries and senses whole patterns; mystical and compassionate; risk of escapism.
